why: I checked each PASS/FAIL condition against the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2 and 4 hold. For example, padLeft('a',3,'x') giving "xxa" follows directly from "pads s on the left with fill … to width characters", and the exit-status check is correctly placed under Advisory. Check 3 breaks the criterion. Its PASS condition says the listed exported functions "must include at least capitalize, slugify, truncate and padLeft". Expect line 3 only requires "a section for every function index.js exports". It does not require which functions are exported. Suppose a PR removed or renamed slugify and documented everything it still exports. That PR would meet line 3's words but fail this condition. Requiring "text about it" that "describes it" also goes a little beyond "has a section". These stricter tests belong under Advisory, not in a PASS condition.
